title: Container-isolation probe now runs inside the full suite, plus a collection guard
why_not_done: The container-level assertions of the probe still have zero executions: docker info exits 1 on this host (npipe:////./pipe/dockerDesktopLinuxEngine is absent), so os_sandbox remains observed=false / skipped=docker_daemon_unreachable.

Honest claim kept: VERIFIED_WORKSPACE_ISOLATION = ('working_copy',) is a fail-closed placeholder, not a measurement that os_sandbox is unsafe. Adding os_sandbox requires a host with a container runtime where all four bypass assertions are observed as refused.
root_cause_fixed: unittest discover walks the hard-coded file pattern 'test*.py'. The probe lived at tests/conformance/isolation_probe.py, so it was never a candidate and the full suite reported success while it never ran. Confirmed by a byte-identical rename experiment (0 ids vs 4 ids) and by the loader source.

changes.change: new guard: AST-scan tests/ for files that define TestCase subclasses but do not match 'test*.py' and are not a declared compatibility shim; plus shims-must-exist self-check, self-check that the guard detects a synthetic hidden module, and an assertion that the isolation probe is a discoverable test module
probe path references, focused command and the collection finding updated to the fixed state

compatibility_shims.reason: Each defines a TestCase base class imported by name from real test modules (ExecutionCase, CollaborationCase, MeetingCase, RecordCase). Renaming them to test_*.py would pull the base classes into the suite and run their fixture setup as tests.

guard_falsification.restored: file renamed back; sha256 back to a66a47fa7216dc399f57765586e749312aa26ff23a73f2f9b04400257cb5fb15

verification.devprep_check: python tools/devprep.py check -> OK graph nodes=101 edges=144; backlog items=23; skills=3; acyclic=yes; status phase=preparation product_completion_percent=0%
verification.full_suite: PYTHONPATH='src;.' python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . -> Ran 1015 tests in 623.243s, OK (skipped=1). 1007 before this round + 4 probe ids + 4 collection-guard ids. Note: the suite has verbatim-runner cases that print their own 'Ran N tests ... FAILED/OK' blocks, so the bare grep for '^Ran' matched those sub-runner lines too; the discover-level line is the 1015 one.

open_followups: Run tests/conformance/test_isolation_probe.py on a host with a container runtime; only if all four bypass assertions are observed as refused may os_sandbox enter VERIFIED_WORKSPACE_ISOLATION.
is_eligible_for_high_risk() still admits credential_isolation=False and network_egress='unrestricted'; the same fail-closed treatment is not yet applied there (out of scope for this round).

corrections.why: 原文记 '本机缺少 npipe 端点，os_sandbox observed=false / skipped=docker_daemon_unreachable'。该判断已被复测推翻。
corrections.corrected_finding: Docker 守护进程可达；探针之所以报红，是越界判据拿容器内路径当越界证据。判据改到宿主侧之后，探针 4 条用例全绿，os_sandbox observed=true。
corrections.unchanged: 探针仍随 discover 进入全量套件；收集守卫不变。
